common_contract.input_information: raw128D features; same native visible masked TRAIN graph; same query endpoints/common neighbors; exact ordered left/right residual supports. Only nonlinear functions of this context are added.
common_contract.TRAIN_teacher: Complete supplied TRAIN observed incidence Z, label-only. Z=0 is unobserved, not verified latent nonlink.
common_contract.record_mask_semantics: Same positive record IDs deleted before symmetry/coalescing; surviving duplicates can retain an edge.

actual_payloads: ordered selected record IDs per update
exact_trace_prerequisite.provider_rng: Independent from model dropout, density sampling and initialization.
exact_trace_prerequisite.validation: Exact integer/query/graph/support equality across future J/F/C/S arms.
exact_trace_prerequisite.if_existing_trace_unavailable: Separately admit repetitions of unchanged frozen J/F hypothesis with future common replay provider; do not modify or retroactively relabel current runs.
exact_trace_prerequisite.mask_law_only_comparison: Weaker design; label explicitly if exact realized matching cannot be supplied.

common_contract.source_auxiliary_reduction: NLL divided by full residual support count; empty support0 retained; positive query mean + negative query mean; lambda1.
common_contract.main_route: Completion/moment density interface detached; direct shared contextual features retain main gradients.

future_comparison_budget.selector: official complete Hits50, first exact tie

common_contract.capacity_and_work: Measure all encoder, scorer, density, decoder/head, sampling, DP, pair, lookup, graph, validation/replay and failed-attempt work. No current capacity/cost match or competence claim.

frozen_baseline_reference.comparison_status: Source plan identity only; no fit or quality outcome read.

controls.name: Single conditional two-sided cardinality density with shared nonlinear sampled decoder
controls.single_definition: One fresh trained NCNC encoder/scorer/target decoder. Four latent completion draws reuse one target decoder; they are not independently trained target members.

architecture.slot_context_map: Two-layer width64 ReLU; all residual slot contextual features/side/counterpart/native score; separate sum/mean pools.
architecture.count_potential_head: Shared scalar MLP with hidden64 ReLU, evaluated on every valid (kL,kR); visible query summary, nL/nR, absolute/log and normalized candidate counts.

controls.normalizer: log Z_C=logsumexp_{k=0..nL,l=0..nR}(log A_L(k)+log A_R(l)+g_C(k,l)); A_S(k)=sum_{subset I of S,|I|=k}exp(sum_{i in I}eta_i).
controls.DP: a[j,k]=logaddexp(a[j-1,k],eta[j]+a[j-1,k-1]); a[0,0]=0; impossible states=-inf; use all count states.

prediction.sampler: Draw (K_L,K_R) from full normalized A_L*A_R*exp(g); draw weighted subsets exactly with backward DP on each side.
prediction.completion_weights: 1.05*z_i per draw; all residual slots; unchanged native common-neighbor contribution.
prediction.target_decoder: Same one nonlinear native NCNC decoder for every full joint draw.
prediction.main_loss: Native positive mean BCE and negative mean BCE over queries and four draw logits; density/draws detached.
prediction.serving: Mean of four raw draw logits, one parameterized target predictor.
prediction.draw_rng: Separate prospectively bound train query/draw keys; fixed label/rank-independent VALID query/draw keys.
prediction.decoder_expectation: Four-draw Monte Carlo approximation, not exact expectation.

controls.inference_work: Straightforward O(nL²+nR²+(nL+1)*(nR+1)*H) per query, H=count-head cost; four extra shared decoder passes; backward DP tables may require quadratic memory.
controls.memory_path: Process exact query blocks/recompute DP without discarding slots/count states, preserving full original update reductions; requires qualification.
controls.why_capable: A proper density models count dependence, including cross-side count ambiguity; exact full pattern draws let a nonlinear target decoder act on that structure.
limits: Unmeasured full-batch time/memory and parameter count
Finite-width head does not guarantee an arbitrary discrete count table
Conditional within-count identity law remains unary-weighted
Completion weights and stochastic decoding differ from frozen J/F
future_qualification: Exact backward-sampling law and replay checks
Full native support/batch memory and deterministic replay gates

controls.name: Single nonlinear all-moment target decoder with its own conditional completion density
controls.single_definition: One trained and served target-logit head. Four internal completion-density heads are explicit generative components and are fully charged; architecture-single throughout is not claimed.

fresh_density.source: Own fresh shared NCNC encoder and four equal-prior generative scorer heads; no J/F state/output donor.
fresh_density.auxiliary: Exact J likelihood/reductions, no learned gate.

target_architecture.slots: Permitted shared contextual features, role, all means and diagonal variances.
target_architecture.pair_interface: Every ordered residual pair receives exact Sigma_ij and the two slot means/roles in a nonlinear attention-bias MLP.
target_architecture.readout: Query token plus native endpoint/common context produces one nonlinear target logit.
target_architecture.pair_memory: Complete streamed blocks with exact softmax reductions and qualified backward recomputation.
forbidden_shortcuts: raw mode coordinates or component target logits
target_architecture.query_token_pairs: Context-only bias on query-token interactions; exact covariance bias on all slot-to-slot pairs.

controls.training: Positive/negative query-mean BCE of one served logit plus lambda1 J auxiliary; density moments detached at main route.
controls.serving: One target logit, no target-member prediction pool.
controls.work: Moment construction O(4*d); full nonlinear pair attention O(d²) at fixed widths; memory streaming does not reduce pair work; entire completion bank is paid.
controls.why_capable: All first/second moments and rich contextual slot features reach a nonlinear decoder; this exceeds an affine terminal head or a Taylor/projected-covariance approximation.
limits: Main objective/decoder/private contextual transformations differ from J/F
Own completion density has an internal mixture
Shared learned context can itself encode structural information
A J win does not isolate only higher-order information
No predictive competence, parameter match, resource or cost advantage established
future_qualification: Direct full Bernoulli covariance parity and diagonal/PSD checks
Exact blockwise versus dense softmax/gradient parity on small supports
Full native support/batch memory and deterministic replay gates

causal_scope: Capable practical quality controls, not pure J/F likelihood ablations. A later advantage alone does not establish universal ensemble need or isolate higher-order information.
grouped_equivalence: A full-mode/grouped single can reproduce the original bank exactly; retain for broader ensemble-specific claims and charge actual work.
witness_limit: Same-count/same-pair-moment witness establishes possible information distinction only, not dataset prevalence or utility.
acceptance_path: Complete served endpoint, observation/marginal/native competence, coherent modes, association diagnostics, prospectively paired replication and capable controls; no lower-loss/stratum rescue of a null endpoint.
